newsitem.title: USA: Thanksgiving & Nov same-store sales rise - TeleCheck.
newsitem.headline: Thanksgiving & Nov same-store sales rise - TeleCheck.

text.p: Consumers boosted spending over the Thanksgiving weekend, with same-store retail sales up 4.3 percent over last year's period, TeleCheck Services said Tuesday.
For November, same-store retail sales were up 2.1 percent, TeleCheck said.
TeleCheck is a check acceptance company that is a subsidiary of First Data Corp.
The company said the weekend numbers were better than the 3.6 percent same-store increase it reported for the Friday after Thanksgiving.

According to TeleCheck, the Southwest's sales jumped 9.0 percent, the Mid-Atlantic rose 5.7 percent and sales in the West were up 5.4 percent. The Southeast's sales rose 4.6 percent, the Midwest was up 4.5 percent and sales in the Northeast fell 3.5 percent.
TeleCheck said the data are based on a same-store comparison of the dollar volume of checks written by consumers at nearly 20,000 of its subscribing locations.
